name: cache-status
description: Prompt-cache meter above the prompt, built on prompt-cache-control: read / wrote / new tokens per request, a live countdown, why the cache missed, and pop-ups before it lapses; plus what a re-ingest costs in your 5-hour window, what the cache saved today, Keep warm, Start fresh, and a /cache pane with a per-turn table and history

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto follows Claude Code's own rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, the promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1 hour on a Claude subscription and 5 minutes otherwise) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

warnSeconds.title: Warn before expiry (s)
warnSeconds.description: Seconds left at which the band turns yellow, Keep warm appears and the first pop-up comes

compactAtTokens.title: Large context (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: From this prompt size up, an expired cache offers Start fresh before you pay to write the whole conversation again

toast.title: Pop-ups near expiry
toast.description: Pop-ups as the cache lapses: at the warning threshold, then at 10, 3, 2 and 1 seconds (only for prompts of 20k tokens or more)
